If I could change the world in one way, it would be to establish a global, universally accessible education system.

This system would provide free, high-quality education to everyone, regardless ofmanufacturing, wealth, or location. 

This education system would encompass a wide range of subjects, including but not limited to:

- Science and technology
- Mathematics
- History and culture
- Arts and music
- Physical education and sports
- Environmental science and sustainability
- Ethics and philosophy
- Languages and communication
- Economics and business
- Social sciences and psychology
- Public health and safety

By providing comprehensive education to all individuals, we would foster a more informed, compassionate, and united global community. This would enable us to address and solve many of the world's most pressing challenges, including poverty, inequality, environmental degradation, and conflict.
